description: Turn, mirror, then crop a picture; optionally resize the result exactly. Takes image files.

Area.description: A rectangle of a picture, in pixels from the top left corner.

x.description: Left edge, in pixels from the left.

y.description: Top edge, in pixels from the top.

Size.description: A width and a height in pixels.

area.description: The part to keep, in pixels of the picture after `turn` and the flips.

flip_h.description: Mirror left to right (after the turn).

flip_v.description: Mirror top to bottom (after the turn).

output_dir.description: Absolute folder for the results; default: the user's setting.

size.description: Resize the result to exactly this size, e.g. 1080 × 1350 for an Instagram portrait post.

name: image_crop
title: Crop
